# mtncloud_security_package (Data Source)

Provides a MTN Cloud security package data source.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mtncloud_security_package" "tf_example_security_package" {
  name = "tf_example_security_package"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) The name of the MTN Cloud security package.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The ID of this resource.
